plan_a_advantages: Includes a dedicated tempo run for speed development.

reasoning: Plan A is the better training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster. It incorporates a more balanced approach, including a dedicated tempo run and a wider variety of easy runs to support aerobic development and recovery. Plan B, while including long runs, heavily emphasizes volume with two very long runs in a row, which could lead to overtraining and reduced performance. Plan A’s inclusion of a shorter, more focused tempo session is more directly targeted at improving speed, while the recovery runs are strategically placed to mitigate the impact of the longer runs.
